resources.string: Japanese Habit Lock uses the accessibility service to see which app is in front of you, and which screen inside it, so it can block a distraction before your study is done. To tell the Reels tab apart from a message, it reads the identifiers of the on-screen elements. It never reads their text: not your messages, not your posts, not anything you type. Nothing is stored and nothing leaves your phone - the app has no internet permission.
